top_story.title: Bitcoin miner and AI firm Ionic Digital valued at $2.25 billion in Nasdaq debut
top_story.summary: Ionic Digital, a bitcoin miner and AI infrastructure provider, secured a valuation of about $2.25 billion after its shares ‌fell in the Nasdaq debut on Tuesday.  Shares of the company, which ‌went public through direct listing, opened at $50 apiece, down nearly 5.7% from a reference price of $53 ​set by the Nasdaq on Monday.  The tepid debut underscores the volatility in global markets, with investors scrutinizing the need for aggressive spending to build out AI capabilities.
